name: taco bell drive-thru lane
description: the short asphalt loop wrapping the restaurant from speaker to pickup window, cramped under a striped awning. a weather-cracked intercom speaker squawks an order every few minutes; the delivery window glows behind it where cars idle with their hazards blinking. the lane is wide enough for one car, and every car treats that as a suggestion. a menu panel on the order board has a dead bulb, its items rendered in a whisper of light.

environment.noise: car idling, intercom static, distant cicadas

items.name: drive-thru speaker
items.description: a weather-cracked intercom speaker bolted to the wall. when you lean toward it, the garbled audio of a car radio bleeds through the static — some song, someone laughing, a voice order repeated twice.

items.name: menu panel
items.description: a backlit drive-thru menu board with the standard fare, half its bulbs burnt. a handwritten paper strip taped across the 'limited time' slot reads simply 'CRUNCHY WRAP BOX 7.99' in the same sharpie appeared inside on the interior board.

items.name: pickup window ledge
items.description: the little sill where bags are slid out to idling cars. a worn rubber mat is stamped with a footprint pattern and the corner of one bag from the dinner rush still lies there, flattened and unclaimed.
